//: Base settings. appsettings.Development.json is merged on top when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development.

ConnectionStrings.//: Empty here on purpose. In production this comes from an environment variable or a key vault, never from a file in source control.

Jwt.//: Deliberately empty. Startup validation fails loudly if nothing supplies it — which is exactly what you want in production.

App.Name: TicketHub
App.//: Where the FRONT END lives — the reset-password link points at a page in the SPA, not at this API.

Email.//: Console | Smtp | Mailjet. Console writes the message to the log — no credentials needed.
Email.//smtp: Works with any provider. Mailjet's SMTP relay is in-v3.mailjet.com:587, Gmail is smtp.gmail.com:587.
Email.//secrets: SmtpPassword, MailjetApiKey and MailjetApiSecret are CREDENTIALS and must never be committed. Supply them with: dotnet user-secrets set "Email:SmtpPassword" "..." locally, and an environment variable or key vault in production.

RateLimit.//: Development can be generous; production should be strict. Numbers live here so changing them is not a rebuild.

Cors.//: Explicit origins, because SignalR needs AllowCredentials and a browser refuses to combine that with a wildcard.
